# v2026.10.35

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.35.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.35.md).

This release covers **4 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- The Jobs page has Group, Sort and Filter, and each account keeps its own choice. ([#173](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/173))
- Job cards drag between lanes, and the Jobs board can group by a custom field. ([#175](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/175))
- A job that changed after its draft shows what it was and what it is now, on the draft. ([#172](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/172))
- A draft invoice has Preview, Save as draft and Finalise, and drafts step through their list. ([#172](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/172))
- Releases now ship from release branches, with full validation every 3 hours, signed tags and correction versions. ([#165](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/165))

## Changes

- Group, Sort and Filter on the Jobs page, saved per account. ([#173](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/173))
- Drag job cards between lanes, and group the Jobs board by a custom field. ([#175](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/175))
- A changed job shows was and now on its draft; Preview, Save as draft, Finalise; drafts step through their list. ([#172](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/172))
- Release branches, 3-hourly full validation, signed tags, corrections and release:stable, copied from OpenClaw. ([#165](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/165))
